materials.title: Lost Water Bottles 010
materials.text: Three water bottles are by the door. The tall green bottle is Joe’s. The short green bottle is Eve’s. The blue bottle has no name. Joe is in the hall. Eve is in class. Give the blue bottle to the lost-and-found desk. Do not drink from it.

questions.prompt: A friend takes the tall green bottle to Eve. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A高绿瓶属Joe；B两个绿瓶全属Eve错误；C蓝瓶无名不是已知Joe物。

questions.prompt: A friend wants Eve’s bottle. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B矮绿瓶属Eve；A高绿属Joe；C蓝无名。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to return Joe’s bottle now. You say, "____"
options: Joe is in our class now.
Take it to Joe in the hall.
questions.explanation: C：Joe在礼堂可送还；A家中、B教室均非已知位置。

questions.prompt: A friend asks what to do with the blue bottle. You say, "____"
options: Give it to the lost-and-found desk.
Take it home as a gift.
questions.explanation: A无名蓝瓶交失物处；B擅写Eve名、C当礼物取走均不合。

questions.prompt: A thirsty friend opens the blue bottle. You say, "____"
options: Do not drink from that bottle.
Share it with the whole class.
questions.explanation: B无名瓶明确不能饮用；A喝完、C全班分享均违规则。

materials.title: Bus Seat Buddy 010
materials.text: Our bus seats have number cards. Sit with your partner, not alone. A bag stays under your own seat. Keep the middle path clear. The bus moves only after everyone sits down. At the park, wait until the teacher says to get off.

questions.prompt: A friend sits alone away from a partner. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A要求与同伴同坐；B坐包不是安排；C站通道妨碍通行。

questions.prompt: A friend leaves a bag in the middle path. You say, "____"
options: Put it outside the moving bus.
questions.explanation: B包收自己座下并清通道；A司机身上、C车外均非位置。

questions.prompt: The driver is ready, but a child is standing. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C全员坐好才能动；A忽略站立者；B跳不能满足坐下条件。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to change seats while the bus moves. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A遵守坐好且同伴同坐；B跑、C站门均违坐下要求。

questions.prompt: The bus reaches the park. A friend starts to get off before the teacher speaks. You say, "____"
options: Go back to sleep at home.
questions.explanation: B到站等教师许可；A抢挤未许可；C家中睡觉非现场下一步。

materials.title: Missing Shoe Laundry 010
materials.text: I cannot find one of my trainers. I look under the bed, but it is not there. Mum asks me to look in the laundry basket. I find a red sock, not my trainer. Then our puppy runs past with something white. It is my shoe! The puppy drops it beside the sofa. The shoe is wet, so I wear my other pair to school.

questions.prompt: The trainer is under the bed.
questions.explanation: B正确：look under bed但not there；A把寻找地点当找到地点。

questions.prompt: The writer finds a red sock in the laundry basket.
questions.explanation: A正确：篮中发现red sock；B否认具体物品。

questions.prompt: The puppy has the missing shoe.
questions.explanation: A正确：小狗叼白物即my shoe；B否认找到原因。

questions.prompt: The puppy leaves the shoe beside the sofa.
questions.explanation: A正确：drops beside sofa；B与落下地点相反。

questions.prompt: The writer wears the wet shoe to school.
questions.explanation: B正确：鞋湿改穿other pair；A把找到的湿鞋当出门穿鞋。

materials.title: Two Kitchen Clocks 010
materials.text: There are two clocks in our kitchen. The big wall clock has a loud tick. The little clock on the shelf is quiet. Dad takes the battery out of the wall clock to clean it. It stops at eight. The shelf clock still works. I look at the wrong clock and think I am early. Mum points to the shelf. It is half past eight, and we must leave now.

questions.prompt: The wall clock has a loud tick.
questions.explanation: A正确：big wall clock loud tick；B否认特点。

questions.prompt: Dad removes the wall clock’s battery to clean the clock.
questions.explanation: A正确：takes battery out to clean it；B否认目的。

questions.prompt: Both kitchen clocks stop at eight.
questions.explanation: B正确：仅墙钟停，架钟still works；A把一个扩大两者。

questions.prompt: The writer first checks the shelf clock.
questions.explanation: B正确：先看错墙钟才以为早；A架钟是妈妈指示后的来源。

questions.prompt: The working clock shows half past eight.
questions.explanation: A正确：架钟有效且8:30；B与实际时间相反。

units.title: 校园邮递角的姓名核对

materials.title: School Post Desk 010
materials.text: The school post desk receives letters for pupils. Helpers sort them by class, then by first name. Two pupils in Class Four are called Alex. One is Alex Wu, and the other is Alex Green. A letter arrives with only "Alex, Class Four" on it. The helper does not open it. She asks the school office to contact the sender. The sender says it is for Alex Green and gives the full name for the record. The helper adds the surname to the outside of the envelope and gives it to the right pupil.

questions.prompt: How are letters sorted first?
questions.explanation: A先按班再名；B颜色、C大小不是分拣标准。

questions.prompt: Why is one letter difficult to deliver?
options: Two pupils in the class share the first name.
questions.explanation: B同班两Alex仅名不足；A有信封；C没有全班缺席信息。

questions.prompt: What does the helper avoid doing?
questions.explanation: C不拆信；A请办公室联系；B核实全名有执行。

questions.prompt: Who confirms the intended pupil?
questions.explanation: A寄件者明确Alex Green；B司机、C另一Alex未确认。

questions.prompt: What is added to the envelope?
questions.explanation: B加姓区分；A身高无关；C未拆读内容。

materials.title: Playground Chalk Calendar 010
materials.text: Our class draws a big calendar on the covered playground. Each square is one day. We use white chalk for dates and yellow chalk for club times. On Tuesday, the chess club changes from Friday to Thursday. We rub out only its yellow words, not the date. Then we write the new time in Thursday’s square. The teacher asks us to copy the change onto the class noticeboard too. Children who do not pass the playground still need to know about it.

questions.prompt: Each calendar square stands for one day.
questions.explanation: A正确：each square one day；B否认结构。

questions.prompt: White chalk is used for club times.
questions.explanation: B正确：white日期、yellow社团时间；A互换颜色用途。

questions.prompt: The chess club moves from Friday to Thursday.
questions.explanation: A正确：Friday to Thursday明确；B否认变更方向。

questions.prompt: The class erases Thursday’s date when changing the club time.
questions.explanation: B正确：仅擦社团黄字不擦日期；A混淆擦除对象。

questions.prompt: The change is also copied to the class noticeboard.
questions.explanation: A正确：teacher asks copy change there too；B否认补充传播渠道。

units.title: 食品募集活动的清单边界

materials.title: Food Drive Item List 010
materials.text:
Class notice: Food collection for the community pantry
Please bring unopened, labelled food that can be stored without a fridge. Rice, dried beans and sealed tins are welcome. Do not bring home-cooked meals, opened packets or glass jars. Volunteers cannot check how these have been stored, and glass can break during transport. Check the date before donating. The collection closes on Thursday at noon. Put food on the table outside Room 8, not in the school office. If you are unsure about an item, ask Ms Cole before bringing it. Families may also help by carrying boxes after school; donating food is not the only way to take part.

questions.prompt: Which item meets the stated rules?
options: An unopened labelled tin of beans.
questions.explanation: B密封有标签罐装豆且无需冷藏；A开封、C自制餐、D玻璃瓶均明禁。

questions.prompt: Why are home-cooked meals not accepted?
options: Volunteers cannot check their storage history.
questions.explanation: C无法核查保存；A价格、B所有人讨厌、D颜色均非原因。

questions.prompt: When does collection end?
questions.explanation: A周四中午；B周四放学后已晚；C周五、D周三均不符。

questions.prompt: Where should donations be placed?
questions.explanation: D8室外桌；A明确非办公室；B沙地、C司机旁未安排。

questions.prompt: How can a family help without giving food?
options: Leave glass jars by the gate.
questions.explanation: B放学后搬箱亦参与；A开封、D玻璃瓶违规则；C忽视规则非帮助。

units.title: 游泳成绩表上的计时说明

materials.title: Swimming Results Timing 010
materials.text:
At sports day, pupils swam the same short distance in two groups. The morning group used an electronic timer. After lunch, the device failed, so two teachers used hand-held stopwatches. The afternoon times appeared slightly slower. A pupil wanted to rank everyone in one list immediately.
The sports teacher explained that the distance had stayed the same but the timing method had changed. Small differences might come from how the stopwatches were started and stopped. It would be unfair to treat every tiny difference as certain proof of a faster swimmer.
The school displayed results in two sections and stated which method each used. Pupils with close times could join another supervised swim on a later day if they wanted a common comparison. Nobody had to repeat the swim to receive a participation certificate. The teacher said a result sheet should show both the measured numbers and enough information to understand them.

questions.prompt: What changed between the two groups?
options: The length of every swimmer’s arm.
questions.explanation: B电子计时改手持秒表；C距离相同；A臂长、D证书类型无变化信息。

questions.prompt: Why did the teacher oppose immediate ranking by tiny differences?
options: No pupil had finished the swim.
Timing methods could introduce small differences.
questions.explanation: C手动启停可带来误差；A秒表功能错误；B已完成；D未一概否定电子计时。

questions.prompt: How were the results displayed?
options: In two sections with timing methods stated.
As a single list without notes.
questions.explanation: A分两区注明方法；B无说明反原文；C早晚都有；D保留数字。

questions.prompt: What could pupils with close times choose to do?
options: Demand a certificate from another school.
Swim again under a common method.
questions.explanation: D可自愿重游统一比较；A秘密改、B逃课、C他校证无据。

questions.prompt: Who had to repeat the swim to get a participation certificate?
questions.explanation: B明确nobody had to repeat；A和D整组强制、C最快者强制均无要求。
